RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Senior risk modelling leadership roles heavily weight regulatory affairs, supervisory interaction, and stakeholder management alongside quantitative expertise. The appointed candidate possessed strong, directly relevant qualifications for this level. 

An all-female panel is not evidence of bias, just as an all-male panel does not inherently indicate discrimination. Raising an allegation of sex discrimination without concrete evidence will not alter the outcome, carries virtually no legal viability, and risks severely damaging your professional reputation and industry network. 

Instead, send a professional follow-up politely requesting constructive feedback on how to strengthen your candidacy for future leadership opportunities, focusing on strategic and regulatory competencies.
